results.question: how should I warm up for tendonitis?
results.answer: For tendonitis, warm up your joints properly before any heavy work, and build the load gradually—tendons adapt more slowly than muscles. Isometric holds under load can also help build tendon strength. Make sure to take it easy if your tendons feel sore, and consider seeing a physio or doctor if it persists.
